info.name: Fetch URL
info.description: Fetch a single web page and return its contents as Markdown. Supports pagination via start_index and raw HTML mode.

info.name: Time & Timezones
info.description: Get the real current time in any IANA timezone, and convert a time between two timezones (handles DST).

info.name: Sequential Thinking
info.description: A structured step-by-step reasoning scratchpad. Lets the model lay out numbered thoughts, revise earlier ones, and branch alternatives before answering.

info.name: Knowledge Graph Memory
info.description: Persistent memory as a knowledge graph of entities, relations, and observations. Survives across chats; supports create, search, read, and delete.

info.name: Filesystem (~/AI, read-only)
info.description: Read-only access to the ~/AI workspace: read files, list and walk directories, search, inspect metadata. Writes (write_file/edit_file/create_directory/move_file) are refused by the proxy.

info.name: DuckDuckGo Search
info.description: Web search via DuckDuckGo plus a fetch_content helper that extracts readable text from a result URL.

info.name: Git
info.description: Inspect and operate on git repositories under ~/AI: status, diff, log, show, add, commit, branch, and checkout.

info.name: Crawl4AI (content only)
info.description: Browser-backed crawling: clean Markdown, raw HTML, screenshots, PDFs, single and multi-URL crawls. Arbitrary JS execution (execute_js), token minting and the /monitor admin surface are refused by the proxy.

info.name: GitHub (read-only)
info.description: Read-only GitHub: search repos/code/issues/users, read files, commits, issues and PRs. Mutating operations are removed from the spec and refused by the read-only proxy on :8212.

info.name: Filesystem Extras (read-only)
info.description: Read-only access to ~/Work, ~/AI and the openclaw workspace: read files, list and walk directories, search, inspect metadata. Writes are refused by the proxy.

info.name: SearXNG Search
info.description: Private metasearch through the local SearXNG instance, with category/engine/time filters, plus a URL-to-Markdown reader.

info.name: Playwright Browser (no exec)
info.description: Headless browser: navigate, click, type, fill forms, screenshot, read accessibility snapshot/console/network. Code execution (run_code_unsafe, evaluate) and local-file upload (file_upload, drop) are refused by the proxy.

info.name: arXiv Papers
info.description: Search arXiv, fetch abstracts, download full paper text, and manage a local library of downloaded papers.

info.name: Hugging Face Hub (read-only)
info.description: Read-only Hugging Face Hub: search models/datasets/Spaces, read repo details and model cards, browse repo filesystems via hf_fs. Creating repos/Spaces and running remote compute (hf_jobs, dynamic_space) are refused by the proxy.

info.name: Wolfram
info.description: WolframAlpha natural-language queries and full Wolfram Language evaluation for symbolic math, calculus, units, and curated data.

info.name: Wolfram Plot
info.description: Render Wolfram Language plotting code (Plot, Plot3D, ListPlot, ...) and return the result as an image.
